P00-AC-01.requirement: Exact identities are authenticated and recorded.

P00-AC-02.requirement: The logical PostgreSQL target identity is my_pa.

P00-AC-03.requirement: The legacy SQLite source is documented as read-only and rename or mutation remains unauthorized.

P00-AC-04.requirement: Implementation is not self-authorized and no successor activates automatically.

P00-AC-05.requirement: The migration goal, phase, and work-item structure is published and internally consistent.

P00-AC-06.requirement: A practical branch and worktree strategy is defined and usable for later implementation.

P00-AC-07.requirement: Logging and audit rules exclude content-bearing and sensitive values.

P00-AC-08.requirement: Public target surfaces use neutral my_pa naming and former-employer names remain only in explicit historical, compatibility, or evidence contexts.

acceptance_rule: The implementing context may record DEMONSTRATED only. PASS for P00-AC-06 through P00-AC-08 requires a role-separated exact-head review. Later commits invalidate the review.
